ios.desc:
Did you know there can be a difference of 40 cents per litre between the cheapest and most expensive service stations?
 
FuelCheck gives you real-time fuel prices at your fingertips. Over 2300 service stations in NSW and 60 service stations in ACT upload fuel prices in real-time. You can find the cheapest fuel near you anytime anywhere.
 
You can personalise the app by adding your favourite stations and addresses. Set up alerts for your favourite station or when the price drops under a certain threshold.
 
My trip feature helps you locate the cheapest fuel on your route.
 
Ability to report a price mismatch if the price displayed in the service station is different to the app.
 
Trends allow you to see the price cycle, cheapest day to fill and price range in your local area and compare prices for different fuel types.

quotes.text:
This sort of thing works well for individuals. Eg.

https://www.fuelcheck.nsw.gov.au/app/FuelPrice/ByLocation?latitude=-34.0&longitude=151.0&nearbyme=true&radius=3

Then you need the integration into home assistant for your local options.

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/nsw_fuel_station/

And an app for ease of use when you're out of your local area.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=au.gov.nsw.onegov.fuelcheckapp&hl=en_AU&pli=1

https://apps.apple.com/au/app/nsw-fuelcheck/id1266569551

How does it affect things across the economy for fuel purchase? Haven't seen a study. It would incentive-ise price cutting to increase sales, especially by the independent operators, by essentially advertising the lower pricing for free, is my guess.
